within_pair: Arms remain sequential; first arm alternates by frozen case order.
wall_time_limit: Shared host also runs integration checks. At most two distinct experiment batches may overlap. Wall times are observations under this recorded workload, not isolated performance estimates; report tokens/correctness as primary paired outcomes.
scope: Disjoint caps, not each batch independently spending the entire CNY120. Within-batch cost counters start at zero; historical cost/reserves above counted once. Unspent allocation released only after batch settles; no repeated task output directory.
